name: Engineering Fluid Mechanics
summary: Fluid statics and flow for engineers: control-volume analysis, dimensional analysis, pipe flow, drag and lift, and pumps.

topics.name: Fluid properties: density, viscosity, surface tension, vapour pressure
Fluid statics: pressure, manometry, hydrostatic forces on surfaces, buoyancy and stability
Fluid kinematics: Lagrangian and Eulerian descriptions, streamlines
Control-volume analysis: conservation of mass, linear and angular momentum, energy
Differential analysis: continuity and Navier-Stokes equations (introduction)
Dimensional analysis, Buckingham Pi theorem and similitude
Internal flow: laminar and turbulent pipe flow, Moody chart, major and minor losses
Piping networks and flow measurement (Venturi, orifice, Pitot tube)
External flow: boundary layers, drag and lift
Pumps and fans: performance and system curves, affinity laws, NPSH and cavitation
Introduction to compressible flow: Mach number and speed of sound
